description:
[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10118290)

Let's meet every day from now on. If you don't like it, just stop the interview.

I, the best shortstop in Korea, Lee Ki-Tae, have a female friend, the pale and absent-minded Ji Eun-Ju.

'Please interview me.'

Why are you interviewing me now when you're
always so innocent? Ji Eun-Ju always took people's by surprise like this.

"You answered the question about why you became a baseball player today, right? I'll answer only one question a day for the next week, so let's meet every day.I have no regrets. If you don't like it, just stop the interview."

That should be enough to tease you, who wants to avoid me, right ?
This time, I won't be as docile as you want me to be, Ji Eun-Ju !
